description: onGetObject with regexp literals shared by request threads (#585)

RegexpRead.onGetObject: const r = /^(?<w>[a-z]+)-(\d+)$/i; const kept = r; const id: string = current::objectId; return { "m": regexp_match(id, kept), "i": regexp_index_of(id, /\d/), "r": regexp_replace(id, r, "${w}:$2") };
